items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Frank Goody. No, I don't know him. I know Bibb Matthews, Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: I'd like to run into him sometime and then I could be glad to go to his house too. He usually interviews people out at the homes of the musicians and it's a little bit noisy in here with all the traffic going by and the fire engines today.
Do you remember much about Frank Matthew? Frank Matthew? Yeah. He led a band at the Tivoli in Mexico with Charlie Love, Deucin.
Frank Goody. No, I don't know him. I know Bibb Matthews, Bill Matthews.
